description: The routing criteria action: update_routing_criteria with routing_criteria an object holding steps, a list of three objects, each expression written with jsonencode and Flow language keys in byte order (an OrExpression holding an AndExpression of two AttributeConditions and an AttributeCondition, an AndExpression of two, and an AttributeCondition whose Value is a JSONPath), ProficiencyLevel an HCL number, the first two steps with an expiry object whose duration_in_seconds is the integerString written as a number, the last without one, and the catch-all; the same type with its Steps a JSONPath, which a list attribute cannot hold, as a generic block; and update_contact_target_queue with a JSONPath queue and transfer_contact_to_queue around them. No refs: a predefined attribute is named by a string. Awaits the provider release that carries this block (tasks/D10), so it has no validate directory yet.
